product_title: Handcrafted Pink Lotus Decorative Diya Holder Pair with Golden Mirror Work
product_description: Elevate your festive home decor with this beautifully designed Pink Lotus Decorative Diya Holder Pair. Featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, intricate golden floral patterns, sparkling stone embellishments, and elegant mirror detailing, these diya holders bring a luxurious traditional touch to your celebrations. The artistic lotus-inspired design, rich pink accents, and ornate golden finish create a stunning decorative centerpiece for your home. Perfect for decorating pooja rooms, home temples, festive tables, and entranceways, this decorative pair is ideal for Diwali, Lakshmi Puja, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other auspicious occasions. Add a touch of traditional Indian artistry and festive elegance to your home with these beautiful diya holders.
product_care_suggestion: Gently clean with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Avoid washing or immersing the product in water to protect the decorative stones, mirror work, and golden finish.
Keep away from excessive moisture and humidity to maintain the product's appearance.
Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight to preserve the vibrant pink color and decorative finish.
Do not use harsh chemicals, detergents, or abrasive cleaning materials.
Handle the lotus motifs and stone embellishments carefully to prevent damage or detachment.
Store in a cool, dry place inside a protective box when not in use.
If using with a diya, keep flames and heat away from decorative elements and any non-metal components. Never leave a burning diya unattended.
